subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

She was __elated __about her promotion, but her colleague felt quite disheartened.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"elated"** means very happy and excited. (उत्साहित)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **elated** when she received the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• **"Discouraged" **means having lost determination or confidence; discouraged. (हतोत्साहित)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **discouraged** after failing the exam for the third time.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the **opposite** of **'elated' **is **'discouraged.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cheerful **(प्रसन्न): Noticeably happy and optimistic.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a cheerful personality that brightens up the room.
 
 
 
• **Proud **(गर्वित): Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements.
 
 
• **Example: **He felt proud after winning the championship.
 
 
 
• **Delighted** (प्रसन्न): Feeling or showing great pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** He was delighted to hear about the good news.
